text: Form fields and labels when focused or scrolled to (sticky header overlap): After Send message, focus jumps to the first invalid field (Name), but its label and most of the input sit under the sticky header. Only the bottom edge of the focus ring is visible, so users cannot see which field failed. Expected after the fix: In the shared form-field component, scroll the field group's wrapper (label + input), not the bare input. Set scroll-margin-top to header height + 24px (72+24 = 96px on phone and desktop) on the wrapper and on all inputs, selects and textareas. Then call focus({preventScroll:t

Select fields (What can we help with?, Company size): The native chevron sits flush against the right border on phone and desktop, and the selects look different from the text inputs. Expected after the fix: In the shared select style, set appearance:none and padding-right:48px. Add a custom chevron icon (20px, onSurfaceVariant) positioned 16px from the right edge and vertically centered. Keep the same height, radius and outline token as the text inputs.

Form top: missing error summary: With three errors spread down a long form, the phone view gives no overview, and the Message error sits off-screen. Expected after the fix: Above the first field, add an error banner: errorContainer background, onErrorContainer text, 16px padding, 8px radius, 24px bottom margin. Text: 'Please fix 3 fields:' followed by in-page links to each invalid field. Move focus to this banner on a failed submit, instead of to the Name input.

Desktop 'What happens next' aside: The aside scrolls away with the page, leaving the right column empty beside the long form. The reassurance content disappears exactly when errors appear. Expected after the fix: Make the aside column position:sticky with top:96px (header 72 + 24) and align-self:start, so it stays visible beside the form while the user scrolls. Desktop only; keep the stacked layout on phone.

'Required' pill badges on labels: The outlined pills on Email and Message are visually heavy, and on desktop they look like tiny buttons next to 16px labels. Expected after the fix: In the shared label component, replace the outlined pill with inline text '(required)' in labelMedium, onSurfaceVariant color, 8px left margin, no border.
